narrative.overview: Casita Capital School is an Operate-mode academic command center built for daily family homeschooling, classical co-op coordination, and physical weekly binder printing. Its visual world replaces cold, neon-accented SaaS admin templates with the tactile warmth of archival paper, fountain-pen ink, and editorial serif headings (Newsreader) paired with crisp tabular UI typography (Inter).
keyCharacteristics: Editorial Academic Pairing: Newsreader serif for page titles and card headers (h1–h5), paired with Inter (tabular-nums) for high-density tables and controls.
Warm Archival Surfaces: Stone and parchment neutrals (#fcfbf8 / #f7f4ee in light mode; #171614 / #26231e in dark mode).
Strict 6px / 8px Geometry: Every card, button, input, and menu item adheres to the centralized 6px border radius and 8px spatial grid.
Operational Directness: Live academic tables and daily timelines always occupy the primary viewport.

rules.name: The Dynamic Accent Rule
rules.body: Never hardcode a preset's hex or RGBA value in layout or page components. Always reference theme.palette.primary.main so switching the Academy Accent Ink updates every active state cohesively.

rules.name: The No Dark-Glow Rule
rules.body: Never apply colored zero-offset or neon halo shadows on dark surfaces. Use 1px solid structural borders and neutral elevation shadows.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: Functional UI text—including chips, table headers, course subtitles, and date badges—must never drop below 0.75rem (12px).

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Caption Rule
rules.body: variant='caption' is strictly sentence-case and smaller (0.75rem) than body2 (0.875rem). Reserve UPPERCASE exclusively for short 1–3 word overline labels and TableHead cells.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every due date, time slot, score ratio, percentage, and GPA badge must set fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' and format dates for human reading.

rules.name: The Flat-Canvas Card Rule
rules.body: Operational cards use elevation={0} and 1px solid borders. Never nest bordered cards inside other bordered cards.

dos: Do consume colors, typography, 8px spacing, and 6px border-radius (borderRadius: 1) exclusively from src/theme/.
Do format dates in human-readable form (Fri, Oct 18) with fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums'.
Do use semantic interactive elements (<Button>, <ButtonBase>, <IconButton aria-label='...'>) with visible :focus-visible outlines for all clickable controls.
Do surface explicit <Alert severity='error'> banners with retry actions whenever Supabase queries fail.
donts: Don't place static promotional navigation cards on operational dashboards when those links already exist in the sidebar and header.
Don't nest bordered cards inside other bordered cards (nested-cards).
Don't use fontSize below 0.75rem (12px) on any functional text, chip, or badge.
Don't hardcode #0C74E4 or rgba(12, 116, 228, ...) in components; always derive from theme.palette.primary.main.
